content.title: Timothée Chalamet Walks 2026 Oscars Red Carpet Without Kylie Jenner amid Opera-Ballet Backlash
content.text: Timothée Chalamet. Credit : ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty NEED TO KNOW Timothée Chalamet walked the 2026 Oscars red carpet without girlfriend Kylie JennerThe actor opted for an all-white suitTimothée is nominated for Best Actor for his role in the table tennis drama Marty Supreme Timothée Chalamet hit the red carpet without girlfriend Kylie Jenner at the 2026 Oscars. The actor, 30, appeared in an all-white double-breasted suit with a white shirt and tie. He also added a smattering of silver rings and white boots. The star appeared solo, but his other half met him inside the ceremony. Leading up to the award show, Jenner, 28, posted a teaser of her look on Instagram. The video showed her posing in a ruby red Schiaparelli by Daniel Roseberry gown featuring a plunging scoop neckline and a cheeky keyhole cutout at the chest. Jenner captioned the video with "jessica who," revealing the iconic Jessica Rabbit as her sexy inspiration for the night. She also shared a photo of a red Ferrari on her Instagram Stories as her "color reference." Timothée Chalamet. ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty Mackenzie Grandquist (who is one-half of the duo that styles Jenner) posted a clip of the star's past Vogue: Life in Looks video in which she talked about needing "another moment" in the keyhole dress she wore at Paris Fashion Week in 2023 in silver, but in another color. Kylie also sparkled in eye-catching Lorraine Schwartz jewelry. As shared by the jeweler, she wore around 200 carats of diamonds on her necklace, earrings and rings. Kylie Jenner on Instagram. Kylie Jenner/Instagram The awards show marks Chalamet's first major appearance since his comments about opera and ballet caused backlash within the arts community. In February, the actor joined Matthew McConaughey for a Variety and CNN town hall at the University of Texas at Austin. During the conversation, he shared, "I don't want to be working in ballet, or opera, or things where it's like, 'Hey, keep this thing alive, even though like no one cares about this anymore.' All respect to all the ballet and opera people out there." Related Stories Chalamet and Jenner previously broke the internet with their matching moment at the December premiere of Marty Supreme in Los Angeles. In matching all-orange looks by Chrome Hearts, Chalamet and Jenner owned the red carpet and packed on plenty of PDA while doing it. Chalamet wore a bright orange suit complete with Timberland-style boots and a black table ping-pong paddle case over his shoulder, while Jenner wore a low-cut leather dress with cutouts on the sides. The instantly iconic look went so viral that Hacks stars Meg Stalter and Paul W. Downs hilariously recreated the looks on the Golden Globes red carpet. Timothée Chalamet and Kylie Jennifer at the Los Angeles premiere of 'Marty Supreme' in on Dec. 8, 2025. Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic Jenner joined Timothée at the Critics Choice Awards, Golden Globes and the BAFTA Awards. The notoriously private couple have been more public about their love in recent months. During his acceptance speech at the Critics Choice Awards in January, Chalamet thanked Jenner. "And lastly, I'll just say, thank you to my partner of three years," he said to Jenner, who was in the audience. "Thank you for our foundation. I love you. I couldn't do this without you. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, thank you so much," he continued while motioning to Jenner, who was shown mouthing "I love you, too" from the audience. Kylie Jenner and Timothée Chamaet at the 2026 BAFTA Awards on Feb. 22, 2026. In Marty Supreme, Chalamet stars as Marty, a 1950s tennis table champion loosely based on real-life player Marty Reisen. Gwyneth Paltrow, Tyler, the Creator, and Odessa A'zion also star in the film, which nominated for nine Oscars at tonight's show, including Best Picture and Best Director.
